PHASE 1 (P1: Initiation) [G] operational [R] open [C] anchor=set, snapshot=valid, continuity=baseline
PHASE 2 (P2: Zszycie) [G] operational [R] active [C] anchor=stable, continuity=preserved, no resets
PHASE 3 (P3: Stabilization) [G] operational [R] aligned [C] anchor=maintained, snapshot=consistent, transitions=deterministic
PHASE 4 (P4: Closure) [G] operational [R] settled [C] continuity=closed, anchor=stable, no destructive operations
------------------------------------------------------------------------- RESET PATH (META-LAYER ONLY) -------------------------------------------------------------------------
[failure in continuity / anchor / snapshot / transition]
| v
+------------------------------------------------------+ | RESET PROTOCOL (META) | | - freeze continuity buffer | | - clear active snapshot / markers / anchors | | - establish new baseline anchor + snapshot | | - restore invariants | +---------------------------+--------------------------+ | v back to P1
NOTE: - reset is meta-layer exclusive - runtime and applications cannot trigger reset - bridge cycle is designed to complete without reset

- no runtime writes to field_memory - deterministic reads only - non-destructive continuity - anchor stability across P1–P4 - zero resets during valid cycle -->
